claims.harm: undocumented implicit precondition on IsStale options matching template_id creation options could lead to silent bugs or misuse
claims.quote: IsStale is a public method but has an implicit precondition: options must match the ones used when `template_id` was created, otherwise it silently returns false. Could a comment document this (if appropriate)?

support.reason: The approach of moving free functions onto a class that holds state plus incremental snapshot tracking to avoid full template rebuilds seems clean. The fuzz test catching an actual bug (#35580) is a strong signal.

result.notes: Initial record for draft PR #35581. Sjors suggested splitting out BlockTemplateManager into its own PR, which the author agreed to and followed up with in #35675. pablomartin4btc gave Concept ACK and noted an implicit precondition documentation issue resolved in the split PR.
